summary: C++ gameplay systems, telemetry, test automation, and developer tools. Instrumented 20+ gameplay telemetry attributes for the analytics pipeline and brought a project-specific telemetry system into the shared engine framework. Integrated automated tests into the approval pipeline, reducing build validation by 3 hours per cycle.
Contributed to the worldwide launch of Call of Duty: Warzone Mobile, working on player movement, weapons, vehicles, and UI.
Prototyped Iron Man gameplay in Unreal Engine 5 and Frostbite: character status, combat resources, hit detection, and supporting UI.
